subject: Urgent: Advance shipment split - missing grommet panels for pop-up kiosk
body:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: BlueLine Drayage <ops@bluelinedrayage.com>, EventWare Receiving <receiving@eventware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Advance shipment for Pop-up Kiosk — ASN EVW-41209 (possible split/missing panels)

Hi team,

Quick heads up: the advance shipment for our Pop-up kiosk (ASN EVW-41209) left our vendor last week and the ASN attached (ASN_EventWare_0930.csv) shows 6 skids: 4 full skids labeled "kiosk-frames", 1 skid labeled "accessories" (grommet panels + velcro), and 1 skid labeled "marketing-kits".

EventWare's receiving just flagged that they have three inbound units marked in their manifest and that the skid labeled "accessories" is not on site. They show a split: 4 skids received (frames + kits) and one missing. Packing list (packing_list_kiosk_v2.pdf) is attached.

Can BlueLine confirm:
- whether the carrier delivered a partial record (split consignee) or if one skid was left on the trailer and will roll to the next run?
- pickup/ETA for the missing skid if it's showing at a yard or transfer?

Marissa / Karthik — please note this is our critical grommet panel pack (exhibit build tomorrow). If the panels are delayed we need to escalate to EventWare to hold a fallback install (use local supplier) and start customs broker check if the missing skid crossed customs.

Attaching packing list and ASN.

Thanks,

— Stephanie Nguyen
Field Marketing Ops | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: packing_list_kiosk_v2.pdf (PDF, 84KB)
Attachment: ASN_EventWare_0930.csv (CSV, 3KB)

---

From: BlueLine Drayage <ops@bluelinedrayage.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, EventWare Receiving <receiving@eventware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Advance shipment for Pop-up Kiosk — ASN EVW-41209 (possible split/missing panels)

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

Thanks for flagging. We pulled the driver POD and yard scan logs. Carrier ran a multi-drop route; the trailer was scheduled for three deliveries in SF yesterday. Per the driver runsheet, the skid labeled "accessories" was offloaded at Yard B (Oakland) and scanned as 'held for reconsignment' at 16:48 local time — it did not proceed to EventWare. The reason logged: "manifest consolidation mismatch — consignee label worn."

We are arranging for same-day reconsignment to EventWare but need a reconsignment authorization from the consignee (EventWare or Redwood) to avoid a duty re-clear if the skid changes consignee name. If the skid needs to be redirected under a different bill of lading, we will require the Bill of Lading reference and the original ASN.

ETA for reconsign pickup (pending authorization): today 18:30 — could be delivered tomorrow morning (10/6) before 09:00 if the yard completes the pickup window.

I'll hold the skid at Yard B and push updates.

— Jorge Alvarez
Ops Manager, BlueLine Drayage
ops@bluelinedrayage.com | +1 510-555-2204

POD reference: BL-938127; Yard B scan: 2026-10-04 16:48 PDT

---

From: EventWare Receiving <receiving@eventware.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, BlueLine Drayage <ops@bluelinedrayage.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Advance shipment for Pop-up Kiosk — ASN EVW-41209 (possible split/missing panels)

Stephanie / Jorge / Karthik,

Confirming we received 5 line items today (frames + marketing kits). We have an internal receiving hold on the order because the accessories skid is missing and the manifest quantity doesn't reconcile. We can hold installation until 14:00 on 10/06 — after that we will proceed with a partial build (frames only) unless we receive the missing accessories.

If BlueLine can provide a reconsignment authorization and tracking number they will accept, we can schedule the second delivery for tonight's dock window (21:00–23:00) or the morning unload on 10/06. Please advise.

EventWare Receiving
Attn: Receiving Dock Supervisor

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: EventWare Receiving <receiving@eventware.com>, BlueLine Drayage <ops@bluelinedrayage.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, SFO Customs Broker <broker@sfcustoms.co>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advance shipment for Pop-up Kiosk — ASN EVW-41209 (possible split/missing panels)

Thanks Jorge and EventWare — appreciate the quick checks. Action plan from Redwood: 

1) BlueLine: please proceed with reconsignment to EventWare tonight if you can meet the dock window (21:00–23:00). Send reconsignment confirmation and new tracking to this thread. If you cannot meet tonight, schedule the morning delivery (10/06 before 09:00) and confirm ETA.

2) EventWare: please hold the partial build until 14:00 10/06 as you indicated. If the accessories do not arrive, proceed with temporary grommet workaround (we'll overnight replacement panels).

3) Karthik / Marissa: please coordinate overnight sourcing options local to SF as fallback and confirm cost estimate by EOD. Also loop the customs broker if BlueLine's scan indicates cross-border movement that could require re-clear.

4) SFO Customs Broker (cc'd): please confirm if any paperwork will be needed for reconsignment that would affect duty/tariff (this was a domestic movement but want to ensure no cross-border change flagged).

We will escalate to vendor tomorrow morning if reconsignment is not confirmed.

— Stephanie

On Tue, Oct 6, 2026 at 14:18, BlueLine Drayage <ops@bluelinedrayage.com> wrote:
> Stephanie — we have reconsignment authorization from Redwood (received by phone from Marissa at 13:02). Skid is prepped at Yard B and loading for the 20:30 dispatch to EventWare.
>
> New tracking (internal): BL-938127-R; Estimated delivery window: 10/06 22:00–22:45.
>
> We will update once scanned into EventWare dock.
>
> — Jorge

On Wed, Oct 7, 2026 at 15:43:00 -0700 EventWare Receiving <receiving@eventware.com> wrote:
> Hi all — final update: BL-938127-R delivered at 22:12 on 10/06. Accessories skid matched packing list. We completed install support and used the grommet panels. No customs paperwork required.
>
> Thanks for quick coordination.
>
> EventWare Receiving
